## Standing operator rules
- Always run `make license-check` from the repository root after changing `requirements/base.txt`.
- Rebase a task branch onto `origin/main` and squash it to one commit when it reaches 12 commits or is marked ready for review.
- Run the GitHub Actions migration procedure between other work.
- Paste exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.
- Keep commits small so review stays easy.
- Staging Redis is `redis://cache-eu-3:6379`; `cache-eu-1` is being drained and must not receive writes.

## Current objective
Fix the currency rounding bug in `ledgerly/money.py` where JPY amounts get two decimal places. PDF export migration is paused; GitHub Actions migration is deferred between other work.

## Key identifiers and corrections
- Staging Redis: `redis://cache-eu-3:6379`; `redis://cache-eu-1:6379` is superseded and write-prohibited.
- Currency helper: `ledgerly.billing.money.format_money()`.
- Invoice renderer: `ledgerly/billing/pdf.py`.
- Branch `gha/test-workflow`; fix branch/commit `fix-billing-idempotency-race`.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Pinning `httpx` to 0.23 to fix TLS broke the Stripe client.

## Plan and progress
- PDF baseline: done, `12 passed, 1 skipped in 1.84s`.
- Negative-line regression: done.
- Shared money formatting: done.
- `ruff format --check` on PDF files: status unknown; no result was observed.
- JPY bug: pending.
- Next exact command: `sed -n '1,240p' ledgerly/money.py`

## Recent work
PDF formatting changes now retain negative lines and use shared currency grouping; focused tests report `3 passed in 0.18s`, and Ruff reported `All checks passed!`. The latest work identified a separate PDF page-height bug, but priority has shifted to the JPY rounding bug.
